news.titleEn: Crude oil prices sell off more than 7% on Iran peace talk hopes ahead of U.S. midterms
news.conclusionEn: Brent crude fell 7.6% to settle at $104.77 and WTI dropped 7.4% to $96.46 on Monday as Washington and Tehran both signalled openness to a diplomatic end to the war.
news.conclusionZh: 美伊释放谈判信号，布油单日暴跌7.6%至104.77美元
news.whyEn: It is one of the biggest one-day oil drops this year; cheaper crude eases inflation pressure for consumers, airlines and central banks worldwide.
news.whyZh: 年内最大单日跌幅之一，油价回落将缓解全球通胀以及航空、运输等行业成本压力
news.detailEn: The sell-off followed weekend talks between Iranian and Qatari mediators and reports that a draft proposal to end the war was circulating. Iran's president said the Supreme Leader had granted the government authority to pursue peace talks. WTI briefly fell below $96, and prices kept sliding in early Asian trade on Tuesday. However, the risk of renewed strikes after Tuesday's U.S. midterms means volatility is likely to stay high.
news.detailZh: 周末伊朗与卡塔尔调停方会谈，外界传出结束战争的协议草案正在流传，引发抛售。伊朗总统表示最高领袖已授权政府推进和谈。WTI一度跌破96美元，周二亚洲早盘油价继续下跌。不过美国中期选举后仍有重启空袭的风险，油价波动料将持续剧烈。

news.titleEn: Big Tech Selloff Pushes Nasdaq 100 Into Correction on AI Spending Worries
news.conclusionEn: The Nasdaq 100 fell 1.4% to 27,989.82 on Monday, more than 10% below its Oct. 6 peak, as a chip-stock rout extended to 12% over three days.
news.conclusionZh: 纳指100较10月高点跌超10%，正式进入技术性回调
news.whyEn: It shows investors are losing patience with massive AI spending, and the selloff is spreading to Asian chip-heavy markets like South Korea.
news.whyZh: 显示投资者对巨额AI投入失去耐心，抛压已蔓延至韩国等芯片权重大的亚洲市场
news.detailEn: This is the Nasdaq 100's third correction of 2026, though it is still up about 11% for the year. Megacap earnings showed hyperscaler capex and cash burn worrying investors, while the Dow rose 0.4% as money rotated out of tech. On Tuesday, South Korea's Kospi fell more than 3% at the open, with Samsung Electronics down over 4%. The week's jobs data and the midterm results will test whether the rotation continues.
news.detailZh: 这是纳指100今年第三次进入回调，但年内仍累计上涨约11%。科技巨头财报显示云厂商资本开支和现金消耗令投资者担忧，资金从科技股转向其他板块，道指反而上涨0.4%。周二韩国Kospi指数开盘跌逾3%，三星电子跌超4%。本周就业数据和中期选举结果将检验这轮资金轮动能否持续。

news.titleEn: Marvell to Acquire Lumentum in $115 Billion All-Stock Deal Focused on AI
news.conclusionEn: Chipmaker Marvell agreed to buy optical-networking firm Lumentum in a $115 billion all-stock deal, the largest tech-sector acquisition ever outside the SpaceX-xAI tie-up.
news.conclusionZh: Marvell以1150亿美元全股票收购光通信公司Lumentum
news.whyEn: The deal bets that optical connectivity is the next bottleneck in AI data centers and sets up a stronger challenger to Broadcom.
news.whyZh: 押注光互联是AI数据中心下一个瓶颈，打造更强的博通竞争对手
news.detailEn: Lumentum holders will receive 4.5 Marvell shares per share and own about 33% of the combined company. Marvell expects more than $1 billion in annual cost synergies, a $550 billion addressable market and earnings accretion in the first year after closing. The deal is expected to close in the first half of 2028, leaving a long window for antitrust review. It is the biggest M&A deal of 2026 by equity value.
news.detailZh: Lumentum股东每股可换得4.5股Marvell股票，合并后持股约33%。Marvell预计每年可实现逾10亿美元成本协同，潜在市场扩大至5500亿美元，交割后首年即可增厚盈利。交易预计2028年上半年完成，反垄断审查期较长。按股权价值计算，这是2026年规模最大的并购交易。

news.titleEn: Trump signals progress on Iran deal as Tehran pushes faster ceasefire
news.conclusionEn: Trump said an Iran agreement "looks like that's coming together very nicely," while Tehran said its seven-step plan could now be implemented within two days.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普称伊朗协议「进展顺利」，伊朗提出两天内落实七步方案
news.whyEn: A deal could reopen Gulf shipping and end a war that has pushed oil above $100, but Trump has also hinted strikes could resume after the midterms.
news.whyZh: 协议若达成将恢复海湾航运、结束推高油价的战争，但选后仍可能重启空袭
news.detailEn: Vice President Vance said Washington has had "a number of good conversations with the Iranians." Iran's foreign ministry spokesman said the plan's timeline was shortened from a week to two days after Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei granted the government new powers. Tehran's conditions include lifting the U.S. naval blockade, repealing sanctions, guarantees against further strikes and a regional ceasefire including Lebanon. Trump has said the conflict will end "very soon one way or the other."
news.detailZh: 副总统万斯表示美方与伊朗进行了「多次良好对话」。伊朗外交部发言人称，最高领袖穆杰塔巴·哈梅内伊授予政府新权限后，方案时间表从一周缩短为两天。伊方条件包括解除美国海上封锁、取消制裁、保证不再遭空袭，以及包括黎巴嫩在内的地区全面停火。特朗普则表示冲突将「以某种方式很快结束」。

news.titleEn: Prediction market traders now see nearly 75% chance of Democrats winning the Senate
news.conclusionEn: On the eve of Tuesday's U.S. midterms, Kalshi traders put Democrats' odds of winning the Senate at about 74%, while Democrats are widely expected to flip the House.
news.conclusionZh: 中期选举前夕，预测市场认为民主党赢得参议院概率约74%
news.whyEn: A divided or Democratic Congress would constrain Trump's agenda on tariffs, taxes and spending, which markets are already pricing in.
news.whyZh: 国会若易手将制约特朗普在关税、税收和支出上的议程，市场已开始定价
news.detailEn: New York Times/Siena polls show Democrats leading in five of seven key Senate races, including Michigan, Texas, Maine, Ohio and Kansas. Republicans currently hold a narrow 218-214 House majority, and Cook Political Report sees Democrats favoured in 220 seats. Wall Street has been preparing for Democratic gains, with gridlock historically seen as neutral to positive for stocks. Results from close races may take days to finalise.
news.detailZh: 《纽约时报》/锡耶纳民调显示，民主党在七个关键参议院席位中的五个领先，包括密歇根、得州、缅因、俄亥俄和堪萨斯。共和党目前在众议院仅以218比214微弱领先，库克政治报告认为民主党在220个席位占优。华尔街已在为民主党获胜做准备，历史上国会僵局对股市影响中性偏正面。胶着选区的结果可能需数天才能确定。

news.titleEn: Apple's stock drops on weak margin forecast in Ternus’ first earnings report: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: Apple posted record September-quarter revenue of $114.5 billion, up 12%, and EPS of $2.10, but shares fell about 3% after hours on a weaker gross margin forecast.
news.conclusionZh: 苹果营收创同期纪录1145亿美元，但毛利率指引偏弱，盘后跌约3%
news.whyEn: It was new CEO John Ternus's first report, and the margin squeeze signals rising costs even as iPhone demand stays strong.
news.whyZh: 新任CEO特努斯首份财报，毛利率承压说明成本上升，尽管iPhone需求强劲
news.detailEn: iPhone revenue was $57.6 billion with only eight days of iPhone 18 Pro sales included, and Services hit an all-time high. Gross margin was 47.9%, helped by about one point from tariff refunds, down from 50.1% last quarter. Apple guided December-quarter revenue growth of 7% to 10% but a gross margin of 45% to 46%, below the 46.3% analysts expected. iPad sales also missed estimates.
news.detailZh: iPhone营收576亿美元，其中仅包含iPhone 18 Pro八天的销售，服务收入创历史新高。毛利率为47.9%，其中关税退款贡献约1个百分点，低于上季的50.1%。苹果预计12月季度营收增长7%至10%，但毛利率仅45%至46%，低于分析师预期的46.3%。iPad销售也不及预期。

news.titleEn: Oracle files to sell $20 billion in new stock, bonds to finance AI buildout
news.conclusionEn: Oracle filed to sell $10 billion of common stock and $10 billion of bonds to fund its AI data centers, sending shares down 8.8% on Monday.
news.conclusionZh: 甲骨文拟发行100亿美元股票和100亿美元债券为AI扩张融资，股价跌8.8%
news.whyEn: It highlights how expensive the AI infrastructure race has become and fuels investor worry about debt-financed AI spending.
news.whyZh: 凸显AI基建竞赛代价高昂，加剧投资者对举债投资AI的担忧
news.detailEn: The stock offering is expected to price around $116 a share, well below Friday's close of $130.67. Oracle shares are down about 33% this year and roughly 50% over the past 12 months. The bond sale led a push by 17 high-grade issuers to raise money before the midterm vote. Selling new shares dilutes existing holders, which is a key reason the stock fell.
news.detailZh: 此次增发预计定价约每股116美元，远低于上周五收盘价130.67美元。甲骨文股价今年累计下跌约33%，过去12个月跌约50%。其发债带动17家高评级企业赶在中期选举前集中融资。增发新股会稀释现有股东权益，这是股价大跌的重要原因。

news.titleEn: China’s Economy Dealt Surprise Setbacks in Risk to Growth Pillar
news.conclusionEn: China's October PMI showed factory growth slowing for the first time since July, with new export orders slumping to the lowest since May.
news.conclusionZh: 中国10月制造业扩张放缓，新出口订单降至5月以来最低
news.whyEn: Exports have been China's main growth engine this year, so weakness raises the odds of fresh stimulus and affects global supply chains.
news.whyZh: 出口是今年中国增长主引擎，走弱将提高刺激加码概率并影响全球供应链
news.detailEn: The weak start to the fourth quarter comes as regulators met banks and brokerages to discuss measures to support the stock market after an October slump. The central bank also conducted a swap operation, a tool from its 2024 rescue plan, to inject liquidity. The CSI 300 rose 0.8% on Monday and the tech-heavy Star 50 jumped over 3%. Separately, Beijing's new export controls on construction equipment like tunnel-boring machines could hit India.
news.detailZh: 四季度开局疲弱之际，监管层约谈银行和券商讨论支持股市的措施，此前A股10月大幅下挫。央行还动用2024年救市计划中的互换便利工具注入流动性。周一沪深300上涨0.8%，科创50大涨逾3%。另外，北京对盾构机等工程设备的新出口管制可能冲击印度。

news.titleEn: Palantir reports booming U.S. commercial revenue growth, topping government for first time
news.conclusionEn: Palantir's Q3 revenue nearly doubled to $2.31 billion, beating estimates, as U.S. commercial revenue jumped 148% and overtook government revenue for the first time.
news.conclusionZh: Palantir三季度营收近翻倍至23.1亿美元，美国商业收入首超政府
news.whyEn: It is rare evidence that enterprises are paying heavily for AI software, though shares still slipped amid the broader tech selloff.
news.whyZh: 证明企业愿为AI软件大额付费，但在科技股抛售中股价仍小幅下跌
news.detailEn: Adjusted EPS was 44 cents versus 41 cents expected, and net income more than doubled to $1.13 billion. U.S. commercial revenue reached $984 million versus $953 million from U.S. government clients. Palantir raised full-year revenue guidance to about $8.53 billion. Shares dipped about 3% after hours as investors remain wary of high AI valuations.
news.detailZh: 经调整每股收益44美分，高于预期的41美分；净利润翻倍至11.3亿美元。美国商业收入达9.84亿美元，超过美国政府收入的9.53亿美元。公司将全年营收指引上调至约85.3亿美元。由于投资者对AI高估值仍存疑虑，股价盘后下跌约3%。

businessTips.explanationEn: Synergies are the extra value two combined companies expect to create beyond what each could do alone. Cost synergies come from cutting duplicate expenses like offices, staff and purchasing; revenue synergies come from cross-selling or new combined products. Cost synergies are usually more reliable, while revenue synergies are often overpromised. Buyers use synergy estimates to justify paying a premium.
businessTips.explanationZh: 协同效应指两家公司合并后，创造出超过各自单独经营的额外价值。成本协同来自砍掉重复开支，如办公室、人员和采购；收入协同来自交叉销售或推出组合新产品。成本协同通常更可靠，收入协同则常被高估。收购方常用协同预期来证明支付溢价是合理的。
businessTips.exampleEn: Marvell says buying Lumentum will save over $1 billion a year in costs. If the deal's premium is larger than the realistic present value of those savings, shareholders lose even if the merger "succeeds."
businessTips.exampleZh: Marvell称收购Lumentum每年可节省逾10亿美元成本。如果收购溢价高于这些节省的合理现值，即使合并「成功」，股东依然吃亏。

businessTips.explanationEn: CAC payback period is how many months it takes for a customer's gross profit to cover what you spent to acquire them. It is calculated as customer acquisition cost divided by monthly gross profit per customer. A short payback means you can reinvest cash quickly and grow without outside funding. Many small businesses aim for under 12 months, ideally much less.
businessTips.explanationZh: 获客成本回收期指一个客户带来的毛利需要几个月才能覆盖获取他的花费。计算方法是获客成本除以每位客户每月贡献的毛利。回收期越短，资金就能越快再投入，不靠外部融资也能增长。许多小生意以12个月内为目标，越短越好。
businessTips.exampleEn: If ads cost $60 to win a meal-kit subscriber who brings $15 of gross profit per month, payback is 4 months. If most customers cancel after 3 months, every new sale actually loses money.
businessTips.exampleZh: 如果投广告花60澳元获得一个餐包订阅用户，每月带来15澳元毛利，回收期就是4个月。但若多数客户3个月就退订，每多卖一单其实都在亏钱。

businessTips.explanationEn: Share dilution happens when a company issues new shares, shrinking each existing shareholder's percentage ownership and often earnings per share. Companies do it to raise cash, pay for acquisitions or reward employees with stock. Dilution is not always bad if the money earns a high return, but new shares sold at a discount transfer value from old holders to new buyers. Investors watch share count growth over time as a hidden cost.
businessTips.explanationZh: 股权稀释是指公司发行新股，导致现有股东的持股比例、往往还有每股收益被摊薄。公司增发通常是为了融资、支付收购对价或用股票激励员工。如果募集的资金能获得高回报，稀释未必是坏事；但若折价发行新股，就是把老股东的价值转给新买家。投资者会长期关注股本增长，把它视为一种隐性成本。
businessTips.exampleEn: Oracle plans to sell $10 billion of new stock at around $116, below its $130 pre-announcement price, so its shares fell nearly 9%. In an all-stock merger like Marvell-Lumentum, Marvell holders are diluted to about 67% ownership of the combined firm.
businessTips.exampleZh: 甲骨文计划以约116美元增发100亿美元新股，低于宣布前的130美元，股价因此大跌近9%。在Marvell收购Lumentum这类全股票交易中，Marvell原股东在合并后公司的持股被摊薄至约67%。
